P0.note: baseline apparent permeability of a hydrophilic 2-4 kDa peptide; median CALIBRATED to the Seeker baseline

k_deg.note: luminal proteolysis rate in the niche without protection

S_post.note: survival after apical entry (intra-enterocyte handling, first pass)

ER0.note: Caco-2 efflux ratio if the peptide is an efflux substrate

p_sub.note: probability that the peptide is an efflux substrate (scenario axis)

A_m.note: mucosal contact area of the niche

EC50.note: PE concentration for half-maximal permeability enhancement (millimolar PE activity, Maher 2016; Twarog 2019)

Emax.note: maximal fold-increase of peptide permeability by the PE

C_tox.note: PE concentration for half-maximal epithelial damage

t_rev.note: epithelial recovery time after PE falls below threshold

IC50.note: efflux-modulator potency (piperine 15-74 uM in Caco-2, Bhardwaj 2002; TPGS sub-mM, Collnot 2006)
